title: The buyer is the consultancy, not the end client
content:
The named categories are system integrators, ERP and similar integrators, management consultancy, and AI change management.

Choosing the consultancy as the buyer follows from the industry criteria: if an industry is network-shaped and already buys consultancy, then the consultancies are the concentration point in an otherwise dispersed market. One integration plus one partner conversation can reach many end clients, which is the only way a small vendor covers a long tail.

It also sets the terms of the pitch. A consultancy buys what makes its own offering more sellable, so the argument has to be about their proposition rather than about the technology's merits.
description: Target categories are system integrators, ERP integrators, management consultancies and AI change-management firms — each reaching clients Powerhouse would not reach directly.
